name: Once upon a time… The Gingerbread Man, de Mairi Mackinnon
description: Biblioteca Municipal Almeida Garrett hosts an English-language storytelling session of The Gingerbread Man for children aged 6 to 10.
longDescription:
Biblioteca Municipal Almeida Garrett hosts an English storytelling session based on Mairi Mackinnon's The Gingerbread Man. Organised in partnership with the British Council in Porto, the session is designed for children aged 6 to 10 to practice their English through stories.

The event takes place on 5 December 2026 at 15:30 in the library, located at Jardins do Palácio de Cristal on Rua de Dom Manuel II. Admission is free.

O evento acontece a 5 de dezembro de 2026, às 15:30, na biblioteca situada nos Jardins do Palácio de Cristal, na Rua de Dom Manuel II. A entrada é livre.
